sections.changelog:
Added

  • `[mvweb_faq]` / `[mvweb_faq_item]` shortcodes with front-end rendering.
  • Native `
    ` / `` markup; accordion and open styles.
  • Exclusive accordion via the native `name` attribute (no JavaScript).
  • Configurable accordion icon color, first-item-open and single-open behaviour.
  • Conditional front-end CSS (enqueued only when a FAQ is on the page).
  • Shortcode support inside text widgets.
  • Single FAQPage JSON-LD per page, merging questions from all FAQ blocks.
  • Duplicate guard: skips our schema when a Yoast FAQ block is present.
  • "FAQ" button in the TinyMCE (Visual) and Quicktags (Text) toolbars.
  • Builder modal: question/answer repeater with drag-sort, collapse,
  • Shortcode is built and inserted at the cursor in both editor modes.
  • Settings page (MVweb Hub): default style, accordion behaviour, schema
  • Per-block icon color override via the `color` shortcode attribute.
  • Builder hint when a block exceeds 6 questions (rich-snippet threshold).
  • Question and answer font size settings (px, 0 = inherit from theme).
  • Question font weight setting (400–700).

  • Schema output now skips duplicate questions (one entry per unique question).
